text:
sam: Quick q — iOS app extension getting 401 on hosted API. We set Authorization: Basic <b64> but server logs say "invalid basic auth". Any quick checks?
maria: can you paste the curl you use to repro locally?
sam: repro curl that works locally:
```bash
curl -v -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n 'app:MYKEY' | base64)" https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate
```
sam: in the app extension our Swift code builds the header like this:
```swift
let pair = "app:\(apiKey)"
let b64 = Data(pair.utf8).base64EncodedString()
request.setValue("Basic \(b64)", forHTTPHeaderField: "Authorization")
```
kevin: looks right. Usually this is an env/config copy issue — trailing newline or hidden char in the API key from plist/xcconfig. Quick check: print hex of the key bytes (on macOS/CI):
```bash
# in shell where API_KEY is set
echo -n "$API_KEY" | xxd -p
```
# or in Swift for debug:
let hex = Data(apiKey.utf8).map { String(format: "%02x", $0) }.joined()
print(hex)
```
aj: also verify you aren't accidentally using a base64 variant that inserts newlines. Use base64EncodedString() without options in Swift. Some old tools add line breaks.
sam: printed hex from the extension debug and I see a trailing 0a at the end ("...3132330a"). so yep newline.
devex-bot: common fixes: trim input and ensure xcconfig has no EOL in the value. In Swift: `let apiKey = rawApiKey.trimmingCharacters(in: .whitespacesAndNewlines)`. Also for a quick curl sanity check: `curl -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n 'app:KEY' | base64 | tr -d '\n')" ...`
maria: small gotcha if you're doing streaming/websocket: URLSessionWebSocketTask needs headers set on the URLRequest before calling `webSocketTask.resume()` or `webSocketTask.connect()` (depending on API); otherwise the auth header may not be sent.
sam: thanks — trimmed the key in the extension and moved header setup earlier. Streaming connect now authenticates and no 401s. :party_parrot:
kevin: nice. can you drop a short note in the PR about the xcconfig lint rule so we don't regress?
sam: will do, adding a tiny script check to strip trailing newlines on CI and updating PR description. thanks all!
